usage: onboard.py [-h] {diagnose,propose-config,write-config,set-attribution,create-branch} ...

Diagnose a repository for the development cycle (/dev-cycle)

positional arguments:
  {diagnose,propose-config,write-config,set-attribution,create-branch}
    diagnose            Where to start, in the recommended order
    propose-config      The .dev-cycle.json keys that can be detected and are missing
    write-config        Write confirmed additions to .dev-cycle.json (never overwrites)
    set-attribution     Claude Code: turn off automatic commit and pull request attribution
    create-branch       Create the integration branch from the production branch

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
